cd /tmp/frames && python -c "
import cv2,numpy as np,glob
fs=sorted(glob.glob('f*.jpg'))
ims=[cv2.resize(cv2.imread(f),(480,270)) for f in fs]
for i,(im,f) in enumerate(zip(ims,fs)): cv2.putText(im,f,(10,30),0,1,(0,0,255),2)
rows=[np.hstack(ims[i:i+4]) for i in range(0,24,4)]
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/grid.jpg',np.vstack(rows))
"
